phrase-sign-push.def: a sign on a door telling you to press it away from your body to open it

phrase-sign-pull.def: a sign on a door telling you to draw it toward your body to open it

phrase-sign-no-entry.def: a sign telling people they may not go in through this way

phrase-sign-emergency-exit.def: a sign marking a door to use to leave a building quickly when there is danger

phrase-sign-out-of-order.def: a sign on a machine or toilet saying it is broken and cannot be used

phrase-sign-no-smoking.def: a sign telling people not to light cigarettes in this place

phrase-sign-no-parking.def: a sign saying you may not leave a car in this place

phrase-sign-staff-only.def: a sign saying only people who work here may go through

phrase-sign-wet-floor.def: a warning sign that the ground has just been cleaned or is slippery

phrase-sign-caution.def: a sign telling you to be careful because there may be danger

phrase-sign-keep-out.def: a sign telling people not to enter a place because it is dangerous or private

phrase-sign-do-not-touch.def: a sign asking people not to put their hands on something

phrase-sign-occupied.def: a sign on a bathroom door saying someone is inside

phrase-sign-vacant.def: a sign saying nobody is inside the toilet or room, so you can use it

phrase-sign-reserved.def: a sign on a table or seat saying it is being kept for someone

phrase-sign-sold-out.def: a sign saying no more tickets or goods are left to buy

phrase-sign-for-rent.def: a sign saying a home or room can be used by paying the owner every month

phrase-sign-for-sale.def: a sign saying the owner wants to give this house or item to a buyer for money

phrase-sign-ladies.def: a sign on a bathroom door meant for women

phrase-sign-gentlemen.def: a sign on a bathroom door meant for men

phrase-sign-no-photos.def: a sign saying you may not take pictures with a camera or phone here

phrase-sign-silence.def: a sign asking people not to make any noise, for example in a library

phrase-sign-beware-of-dog.def: a sign warning that a pet that may bite lives on this property

phrase-sign-first-aid.def: a sign showing where to get quick medical help for small injuries

phrase-sign-no-swimming.def: a sign saying you may not go into the water here

phrase-sign-pay-here.def: a sign showing where to give money for what you buy

phrase-sign-self-service.def: a sign saying customers get things on their own, without a worker's help

phrase-sign-closed-for-lunch.def: a sign saying the shop is shut for a midday meal break

phrase-sign-free-entry.def: a sign saying you do not have to pay to go in

phrase-sign-pedestrians-only.def: a sign saying cars are not allowed and only people on foot may use this street

phrase-sign-no-dogs.def: a sign saying you may not bring pets that bark into this place

phrase-sign-no-food.def: a sign saying you may not eat meals or snacks or have beverages here

phrase-sign-please-wait.def: a sign asking you to stay where you are until someone is ready to help you

phrase-sign-cctv.def: a sign saying cameras are recording what happens in this place

phrase-sign-mind-the-step.def: a sign warning you that the ground changes level here, so you could trip

phrase-sign-cash-only.def: a sign saying you must use bills and coins and cannot use cards

phrase-sign-keep-closed.def: a sign asking people to shut the door behind them and not leave it open

phrase-sign-departures.def: a sign at an airport pointing to where passengers leave on flights

phrase-sign-arrivals.def: a sign at an airport pointing to where passengers come after a flight

phrase-sign-way-out.def: a sign pointing to the door you use to leave a building

phrase-sign-slow.def: a road sign telling drivers to reduce their speed

phrase-sign-school-zone.def: a road sign warning drivers that children walking to class may be in the road
